transcript: You drink coconut water every day? What happens to the body? Secrets your doctor doesn't want you to know. Ah. Listen carefully, young one. First, it helps your body lose unnecessary weight. Coconut water cleanses from within, washing away fat that hides in your belly and thighs. It holds only 13 calories per 100 grams. Yet it is full of gentle fiber that calms the hunger and stops the craving for snacks. Second, the power of youth lives inside it. Coconut water is rich in life force, the antioxidants that fight the invisible enemies which make your skin old and tired. Drink it daily and your skin will stay bright and smooth, like the surface of still water under the morning sun. Third, it protects your inner stream. Its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory nature keeps your urinary system clean and strong, fighting off infections before they grow. Fourth, it brings peace to the stomach. The fibers and enzymes inside help your food move easily through the body, calming discomfort and aiding digestion. Remember, in nature, the simplest things often hold the greatest power. Coconut water is one of those sacred gifts. If you wish to learn more ancient secrets like this, I have shared them all in my e-book, Knowledge Gathered Over 40 Years of Study. You can find it in the link on my bio. Drink with gratitude and stay balanced, my friend.
